clue.text: Seaweed wrapped in lettuce as fuel

indicators.note: the seaweed is wrapped inside the lettuce, so one goes inside the other

parts.note: a cos is a variety of lettuce
alga is a simple seaweed

explanation.surface: Someone proposes burning seaweed rolled in lettuce leaves for energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Coal gas, made by heating coal, was once the standard domestic fuel for lighting and cooking.

clue.text: Scene of fighting with control column?

definitions.meaning: a pit where gamecocks were set to fight
the pilot's compartment where the control stick is found

explanation.definitionFit: Cockfights took place in a pit, and a pilot flies from the cabin holding the joystick.

clue.text: Care for a cricket team yet to be formed

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a cricket team has eleven players, XI in Roman numerals

indicators.note: the letters are still to be formed into shape, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Worry about a cricket side that has not yet been assembled.
explanation.definitionFit: Care in the sense of worry is a synonym for anxiety.

clue.text: Third party fool by mistake included

parts.note: a goose is a silly person

indicators.note: the mistake sits inside the word by

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly brought into a gathering as a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: To play gooseberry is to be the unwanted third person with a couple.

clue.text: Grounds for raising a harlot's vehicle

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising the words reads them from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: tart's, a harlot's, written without the apostrophe
a bus is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A reason for lifting up a prostitute's car.
explanation.definitionFit: Substrata are underlying layers, the ground or foundation beneath something.

clue.text: How strangers may be known to unknowns in bay

indicators.note: the unknowns are placed inside the word for bay

parts.note: a bight is a curving bay of the coast
in algebra y is an unknown, so plural unknowns gives YS

explanation.surface: A riddle about how people in a bay recognise outsiders.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangers are people you recognise only from their appearance, not from acquaintance.

clue.text: See 3
What French game, ending at the start, proceeds noisily through the mud?

indicators.note: the final letter is shifted to the front of the word

parts.note: quel is French for what
chess is a game

explanation.surface: Asking which French game, played in reverse, is the one where you wade through mud.
explanation.definitionFit: To squelch is to make a sucking, splashing sound walking in mud.

clue.text: City whose radiance covers half of heaven

indicators.note: the radiance goes around the other piece

parts.note: glow means radiance

indicators.note: only the first three of the six letters are kept

parts.note: Asgard is the heaven of the Norse gods

explanation.surface: A city whose light spreads over part of the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasgow is Scotland's largest city.

clue.text: Actress Gene has row with soldier

parts.note: a tier is a row of seats
Michel Ney, one of Napoleon's marshals

explanation.surface: An actress quarrels with a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Gene Tierney was a Hollywood film star of the 1940s.

clue.text: Conceited fool to steer the Crest

parts.note: to cox is to steer a rowing boat
a comb is the crest on a cock's head

explanation.surface: An instruction to a vain fool to navigate the Crest, apparently a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A coxcomb is an old word for a vain, showy dandy, from the jester's cap.

clue.text: Lecher embracing boy, a dish

indicators.note: the lecher puts his arms around the boy, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: a roué is a debauched man, a lecher
lad means boy

explanation.surface: A lecher hugging a boy, followed oddly by a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A roulade is a dish of meat or sponge rolled around a filling.

clue.text: Transmitted number in quarry after a while

indicators.note: the transmitted number goes inside the quarry

parts.note: the hunted quarry is prey
transmitted means sent
L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a number

explanation.surface: A hunter's message sent about a number of animals in the quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: Presently means soon, in a little while.

clue.text: Record article for 5 down

parts.note: a log is a written record
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A record of an article intended for a fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 5 down is BERRY: this word goes in front of it to make the loganberry, a raspberry-blackberry cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Placed before the fruit at 5 down it names the loganberry, a hybrid soft fruit.

clue.text: See if fitting — and if you can get away with it

definitions.meaning: test a garment by wearing it in the shop

definitions.text: if you can get away with it
definitions.meaning: to attempt a deception, in the idiom to try it on

explanation.definitionFit: Clothes are tested in a fitting room, while trying it on means a cheeky attempt to deceive.

clue.text: Feud involved getting stuck into little girl in required style

indicators.note: the jumbled feud is pushed inside the girl's name

parts.note: Nelly is a pet form of a girl's name

indicators.note: involved means tangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A family feud drawing in a young girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Needfully means necessarily, in the way that is required.

clue.text: Complete journey from midstream? I don't know whether to laugh or cry

definitions.text: Complete journey from midstream? I don't know whether to laugh or cry

parts.words: Complete journey from midstream? I don't know whether to laugh or cry
parts.note: a swimmer in midstream must travel the whole distance to reach the shore, and the phrase follows both laughing and crying in well-known idioms about making money

explanation.walkthrough: The rich laugh, and the pianist Liberace famously claimed to cry, while heading to deposit their earnings; hence the indecision.
explanation.definitionFit: A full trip from mid-river to the shore, and the idiom of profiting despite critics.

clue.text: Left country in as a former geographical feature in Africa

indicators.note: the country sits inside the words as a

parts.note: Kenya is an African country

explanation.surface: Someone left a country, once a feature of the African map.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Nyasa was the colonial name of the African lake now called Lake Malawi.

clue.text: See 15
"The Quiet American" historian

parts.note: tacit means silent or quiet

explanation.surface: A novel title followed by a historian's name.
explanation.walkthrough: The Quiet American is a Graham Greene novel, used as a title for misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacitus was a Roman historian of the early Empire.

clue.text: One going to hedge?

parts.note: a tool or gardener that cuts the hedge, and also a person who hedges, changing sides to suit

explanation.definitionFit: A hedge cutter, and a political trimmer who shifts position to stay safe.

clue.text: 5 down politician

definitions.meaning: 5 down is berry: this word before it makes the familiar red summer fruit
Jack ..., the British Labour politician and former Foreign Secretary

explanation.definitionFit: The fruit is the strawberry; Jack Straw was a British Home and Foreign Secretary.

clue.text: Jewel reported by prisoner marks decisive crossing

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so the jewel is given by its sound

parts.note: a ruby is a jewel
con is short for convict, a prisoner

explanation.surface: A gem mentioned by a convict marks a turning point.
explanation.definitionFit: Caesar's crossing of the Rubicon river committed him to civil war, a point of no return.

clue.text: Flatter the Guardian when about to attend to student

indicators.note: the Guardian goes around the attending and the student

parts.note: a newspaper refers to itself as we, here the Guardian
to heed is to attend to
L is a learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: The newspaper flatters a student when it pays attention.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheedle is to coax someone with flattery.

clue.text: Force runner to put one into cook and painter

indicators.note: the single letter is put into the word for cook

parts.note: a chef is a cook
I is the Roman numeral for one
John Constable, the English landscape painter

explanation.surface: Instructions to slip someone between a cook and a painter, to make a sprinter for the army.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief constable heads, or runs, a British police force.

clue.text: See 22
Abecedarian's tree

indicators.note: reading the 's as has: the word contains the tree

explanation.surface: A tree belonging to someone learning the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A cedar is a coniferous tree.

clue.text: Sum given to model, one pound

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car
a is one
L is the symbol for pound sterling

explanation.surface: A fee given to a model of one pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A total is the sum of figures added together.

clue.text: Fell having had internal haemorrhage?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, a stomach that bled inside

explanation.definitionFit: To fall over is to topple, and the split reading is a belly that bled.

clue.text: Alkaline insect leading a lot of coppers

indicators.note: the insect comes in front of the rest

parts.note: an ant is an insect
the CID, Criminal Investigation Department, is a body of British detectives

explanation.surface: An ant at the head of a crowd of police officers.
explanation.definitionFit: An antacid neutralises stomach acid, being alkaline in nature.

clue.text: Aerosol for the Lord!

definitions.meaning: placed after the word Lord, this completes the famous Christian prayer

explanation.walkthrough: Write 'Lord' before the answer and you get the Lord's Prayer, the best-known Christian prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: An aerosol is a can that sprays, and the split reading completes the Lord's Prayer.

clue.text: Everyone stops at point made by president and writer

parts.note: all means everyone
to end is to stop
E is east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Everybody halts at a spot created by a head of state and an author.
explanation.definitionFit: Salvador Allende was Chile's president, and his relative Isabel Allende is a novelist.
